title: Skip the gourmet coffeeshop and make your own drinks at home!
text:
Skip the gourmet coffeeshop and make your own drinks at home!. My very first espresso maker about 20 years ago was a DeLonghi - It was quite basic but did the job well. After many years of faithful service, my replacement Gaggia gave up, so I was looking for an espresso machine that could provide ample pressure (and a grinder). Upon unboxing, I was impressed by the solid build quality and overall looks of the La Specialista; is it gorgeous on the countertop and has a bit of a 1950s vibe to it.

Pros: Two independent heating systems (one for milk, one for coffee). You can tamp directly in the filter holder. The advanced latte system lets you choose between flat (hot milk only) or foam. It has three presets for espresso, Americano, and coffee.

Be sure to read the instruction manual before attempting setup. It's worth watching all the DeLonghi how-to videos on YouTube first before setting up for the first time (especially about using the built-in grinder as this is my first machine that has one, and there's definitely a bit of a learning curve). And you may want to experiment with the coffee bean grinder (any whole coffee beans will work; it doesn't have to be "espresso" blend!) to find the grind that's best for you.

This is like upgrading to a Ferrari; absolute beauty! I loved the quick startup (my previous Gaggia took about 10 minutes to prime) and the quality of the crema / coffee (if you are a fan of flavored drinks, you can also make your own mochas or add flavored syrups; I loved the fact that this makes fantastic flat whites). Absolutely gorgeous foam, too.

Overall, I'm absolutely thrilled with the La Specialista and look forward to many years of excellent lattes and cappuccinos!

product_metadata.title: De'Longhi EC9355M La Specialista Prestigio Espresso Machine , 1.3L, Stainless Steel
features: Product note: Please refer to user guide (provided below in PDF) before first use.Note: 1)Too coarse a grind, too little coffee, or insufficiently tamping the grounds before brewing can all lead to inadequate pressure for a proper brew. 2)It is important to note that the amount of espresso extracted will vary depending on the grind size and amount and reprogramming may be needed when the size and amount are adjusted
description: Introducing La Specialista Prestigio by De’Longhi. Created for the passionate espresso and coffee drinker, this elegantly designed, professionally-inspired espresso machine empowers you to precisely handcraft espresso the right way. New features and accessories give you more control over espresso extraction. For starters, The Patent Pending Sensor Grinding Technology delivers precise, consistent grinding and the optimal dose for espresso, every time. Two sensors measure the burrs position and therefore calibrate the duration of grinding process to ensure proper dose and grind size. Then the Smart Tamping Station lets you replicate the perfect tamp — simply activate the lever to press the dose with the right pressure for flawless results, with no mess on your countertop. Dynamic pre-infusion works by automatically adapting the pre-infusion length to the density of the coffee dose, to ensure the entire surface of the coffee dose is evenly and gently wet for an optimal extraction. Next, Active Temperature Control with three temperature profiles reduces temperature fluctuations, thus ensuring the perfect stability to brew a high quality coffee and allows to choose between 3 temperature profiles to set the right temperature for the coffee beans of your choice. And on top of that – there is no waiting time between brewing espresso and frothing your milk for latte with Dual Heating System. La Specialista Prestigio is equipped with two independent heating systems. One thermoblock for extracting coffee and an independent heating system for milk texturing or frothing ensures immediate beverage preparation. La Specialista Prestigio features 2 single wall filter baskets for greater control of each extraction. Finally, the My LatteArt steam wand ensures the right milk texturing for café quality lattes and flat-whites. And for added convenience, use La Specialista’s separate hot water spout to brew an authentic Americano. So whether you’re impressing guests with your magnificent coffee skills or enjoying the personal satisfaction that comes from handcrafting something the right way, the versatile La Specialista Prestigio will give you a more enlightened coffee experience at home.
